text: local p=ThePlayer function MW_BF(id) local x,_,z=p.Transform:GetWorldPosition() local b for _,e in ipairs(TheSim:FindEntities(x,0,z,12,{[[_health]]},{[[INLIMBO]]})) do local o,i=pcall(function() return e.Network:GetNetworkID() end) if o and i==id and e.components.hitchable then b=e end end local c=b and b.components.hitchable if not(c and c:GetHitch()) then return end local h=c:GetHitch() if not(type(h)==[[table]] and h.components and h.components.hitcher) then h=nil local bx,_,bz=b.Transform:GetWorldPosition() for _,e in ipairs(TheSim:FindEntities(bx,0,bz,8,nil,{[[INLIMBO]],[[hitcher]]})) do if e.components.hitcher then h=e break end end end return b,h end --M
label: 21.2 (Remote) BEEFALo AUTO HITCHING (2/5)

text: local p=ThePlayer function MW_BeefGo(id) local b,h=MW_BF(id) if not b or p.components.rider:IsRiding() then return end if h then ACTIONS.UNHITCH.fn(BufferedAction(p,h,ACTIONS.UNHITCH)) end local I=p.components.inventory local _,t=I:Has([[twigs]],1) local _,g=I:Has([[cutgrass]],1) local f=(t>0 or g>0) and (t>=g and [[twigs]] or [[cutgrass]]) local it=f and I:FindItem(function(i) return i.prefab==f end) if it then ACTIONS.FEED.fn(BufferedAction(p,b,ACTIONS.FEED,it)) end local warned=false local n,k=0 k=p:DoPeriodicTask(.4,function() n=n+1 if p.components.rider:IsRiding() then if not warned then warned=true if not MW_Bell(p,b) then p.components.talker:Say([[No bonded bell!]],3) end end k:Cancel() return end if n>12 then k:Cancel() return end ACTIONS.MOUNT.fn(BufferedAction(p,b,ACTIONS.MOUNT)) end) end --M
label: 21.3 (Remote) BEEFALo AUTO HITCHING (3/5)

text: local P=ThePlayer local S=P.HUD.controls.virtualstick P._bw=function(e,n,wx,wz) local A=MW_AR local function go() TheNet:SendRemoteExecute([[MW_BeefGo(]]..n..[[)]],wx,wz) end if not A or P.replica.rider:IsRiding() then go() return end if P._bk then P._bk:Cancel() end local c=0 P._bk=P:DoPeriodicTask(.15,function() c=c+1 if S.touchID~=nil or not e:IsValid() then A.stop() P._bk:Cancel() return end local px,_,pz=P.Transform:GetWorldPosition() local bx,_,bz=e.Transform:GetWorldPosition() local dx,dz=bx-px,bz-pz local d=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dz*dz) if d<=3 or c>60 then A.stop() P._bk:Cancel() go() return end local r,u=TheCamera:GetRightVec(),TheCamera:GetDownVec() A.hx=(dx*r.x+dz*r.z)/d A.hy=-(dx*u.x+dz*u.z)/d A.on=true end) end --M
label: 21.4 (Local) BEEFALO AUTO HITCHING (4/5)

text: local P=ThePlayer for _,h in ipairs(rawget(_G,[[MW_TH]]) or {}) do h:Remove() end if P._bk then P._bk:Cancel() P._bk=nil end local S={} local a=TheInput:AddTouchStartHandler(function(i,x,y) S[i]={x,y} end) local b=TheInput:AddTouchEndHandler(function(i,x,y) if P~=ThePlayer or not P._bw then return end local s=S[i] S[i]=nil if not s or math.abs(s[1]-x)+math.abs(s[2]-y)>25 or TheInput:GetHUDEntityAtPoint(x,y) then return end local wx,_,wz=TheSim:ProjectScreenPos(x,y) if not wx then return end for _,e in ipairs(TheSim:FindEntities(wx,0,wz,3,{[[_health]]},{[[INLIMBO]]})) do if e.prefab==[[beefalo]] then local o,n=pcall(function() return e.Network:GetNetworkID() end) if o and n then P._bw(e,n,wx,wz) end return end end end) MW_TH={a,b} --M
label: 21.5 (Local) Beefalo auto hitching (5/5)

text: local P=ThePlayer local C=P.HUD.controls if C.bs then C.bs:Kill() end local Wd,Im=require[[widgets/widget]],require[[widgets/image]] local B=C:AddChild(Wd([[bs]])) C.bs=B B:MoveToBack() B.D={} B.Q={} for i=1,200 do local d=Im([[images/global.xml]],[[square.tex]]) B:AddChild(d) d:ScaleToSize(4,4) d:Hide() B.D[i]=d end --M
label: 22.1 (Local) Brightshade spawn block rangefinder (1/3) only visible during placing/planting stuff

text: local P=ThePlayer local B=P.HUD.controls.bs local R,N=30,48 B.F=function() local x,_,z=P.Transform:GetWorldPosition() local L={} for _,e in ipairs(TheSim:FindEntities(x,0,z,100,{[[lunarthrall_plant]]})) do local a,_,b=e.Transform:GetWorldPosition() L[#L+1]={a,b} end local Q={} for i,c in ipairs(L) do for j=0,N-1 do local t=j*6.2832/N local px,pz=c[1]+R*math.cos(t),c[2]+R*math.sin(t) local ok=#Q<#B.D for m,o in ipairs(L) do if m~=i and (px-o[1])^2+(pz-o[2])^2<R*R then ok=false break end end if ok then Q[#Q+1]={px,pz} end end end B.Q=Q end --M
label: 22.2 (local) Brightshade spawn block rangefinder (2/3)

text: local P=ThePlayer local C=P.HUD.controls local B=C.bs local pc=P.components.playercontroller local w=C:GetWorldPosition() local k=C:GetScale().x B.t=0 B.OnUpdate=function(s,dt) local D=B.D if not(pc.placer or pc.deployplacer) then if B.v~=false then B.v=false for i=1,#D do D[i]:Hide() end end return end B.v=true B.t=B.t-dt if B.t<=0 then B.t=.5 B.F() end for i=1,#D do local q,d=B.Q[i],D[i] if q then local a,u=TheSim:GetScreenPos(q[1],0,q[2]) d:SetPosition((a-w.x)/k,(u-w.y)/k) d:SetTint(.2,1,.3,.8) d:Show() else d:Hide() end end end B:StartUpdating() --M
label: 22.3 (local) Brightshade spawn block rangefinder (3/3)

text: MW_AL={} function MW_AL.ix() local v=Profile:GetAxisAlignedPlacementIntervals() for i,o in ipairs(AXISALIGNMENT_VALUES) do if o.data==v then return i end end return 1 end function MW_AL.lb() return tostring(AXISALIGNMENT_VALUES[MW_AL.ix()].text) end function MW_AL.go(d) local V=AXISALIGNMENT_VALUES local v=V[math.max(1,math.min(#V,MW_AL.ix()+d))].data Profile:SetAxisAlignedPlacementIntervals(v) TUNING.AXISALIGNEDPLACEMENT_INTERVALS=v ThePlayer:PushEvent([[refreshaxisalignedplacementintervals]]) Profile:Save(function() end) end function MW_AL.mk(n,s,d) local C=ThePlayer.HUD.controls if C[n] then C[n]:Kill() end local b=C:AddChild(require[[widgets/imagebutton]]([[images/global_redux.xml]],[[arrow2_]]..s..[[.tex]],[[arrow2_]]..s..[[_over.tex]],[[arrow2_]]..s..[[_disabled.tex]],[[arrow2_]]..s..[[_down.tex]])) C[n]=b b:SetOnClick(function() MW_AL.go(d) end) b:Hide() return b end --M
label: 23.1 (Local)  Alignment toggle (1/2)

text: local Tx=require[[widgets/text]] local P=ThePlayer local C=P.HUD.controls local W,H=TheSim:GetScreenSize() local w=C:GetWorldPosition() local k=C:GetScale().x local b1,b2=MW_AL.mk([[alb]],[[left]],-1),MW_AL.mk([[alt]],[[right]],1) if C.alx then C.alx:Kill() end local t=C:AddChild(Tx(UIFONT,18,([[]]))) C.alx=t t:Hide() b1:SetPosition((1.025*H-w.x)/k,(0.262*H-w.y)/k) t:SetPosition((1.1111*H-w.x)/k,(0.263*H-w.y)/k) b2:SetPosition((W-1.0278*H-w.x)/k,(0.2639*H-w.y)/k) local pc=P.components.playercontroller if P._alt then P._alt:Cancel() end P._alt=P:DoPeriodicTask(.2,function() if pc.placer or pc.deployplacer then t:SetString(MW_AL.lb()) b1:Show() b2:Show() t:Show() else b1:Hide() b2:Hide() t:Hide() end end) --M
label: 23.2  (Local)  Alignment toggle (2/2)
